paragraphs: Rami bar Pappa. Rav Avya married his sister (needs examination there). He eulogized Rav Avya (I have not found this). Rav Yehudah and Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yehudah stood on the bank of the Pappa River, and Rami bar Pappa stood on the other side. He called to them: ‘May I cross to you to ask a teaching?’ etc.; Yoma 77b.
